sourceChecks.finding: The frozen batch has fifteen four-line units, no new metrical headings and sixty occurrence IDs. Original spellings, hashes, grouping and open source-review flags remain untouched. All new teaching is original educational draft content, not a literal or approved translation.

Selected readings remain provisional: protection with warrior/canopy alternatives; awareness with fearlessness; self-dependence with universal dependence; release with vitality; giving/taking with deen/indwelling; reaching with knowing; speech with a power-related English alternative. Lexical evidence supports speaker/discourse at 120. The draft exposes these choices instead of silently reconciling them.

Exact source repeats carry the same English/Punjabi main wording, ignoring only the terminal stanza counter for comparison. The original counters and line hashes are never changed. New local cautions and passage-specific Study lessons explain the changed context.

Author editorial self-review and separate mechanical/browser tests are not independent-model or qualified Sikh/Punjabi review. Dictionary endpoints that failed to return content were not used as evidence. No PDF analysis or physical-device acceptance is claimed.
